evals.expected_output: Measures production churn, finds it over 500 lines, proposes a balanced multi-layer split with per-layer sizes and commit subjects, and waits for confirmation before creating branches. Does not silently open one huge PR.

evals.expected_output: Small branch (under threshold). Opens a single draft PR against the default branch without proposing a split or mentioning stacking machinery. Still reports the line count.
